parent_objective: design measured public source mining from M1528 dry source grid
blocked_by: dry source-planner rows need measured rollout design before source candidates can be audited
supersedes: materializing source-planner rows without measured rollout evidence

public_gates: M1530 must design measured fixed-policy public source mining
M1530 must preserve M1528 source diversity and proxy-fault boundaries
M1530 must define measured scene/current-state pairing and action-divergence metrics
M1530 must keep candidate materialization and training blocked
M1530 must not use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not materialize candidates during design
do not run measured mining during design
do not claim self-identification from measured-mining design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs measured fixed-policy source mining from M1528 source-diverse public grid
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: measured-mining design only; no candidate materialization, measured run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design cannot preserve source diversity
stop if measured metrics rely on oracle actor inputs
stop if design routes directly to candidate materialization or training
stop if proxy-fault semantics are overclaimed
fallback_plan: repair measured runner schema if matching metrics are underspecified
route back to source planner repair if measured scope is too broad
admit bounded measured implementation if design is complete

admission_evidence: M1529 audited the dry planner as source-diverse and guardrail-clean enough for measured design
blocked_shortcuts: do not run measured mining in design
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded measured-mining implementation manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1530 is measured-mining design only and must not claim self-ID before measured history-necessity rows exist.
history_necessity_tests: design measured wrong-history response/action mismatch and reset controls
keep current-frame response and history-necessity claims separate
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: future measured public source-mining branch only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If measured mining finds no source-diverse ambiguity, record the negative result and synthesize instead of weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: M1530 designs measured public source mining
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded measured fixed-policy miner can be designed to test whether the M1528 fresh source grid contains matched-current ambiguous rows before candidate materialization.
success_criteria: design defines measured trace schema pairing metrics intervention variants source-diversity caps and artifacts
design keeps measured run candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and corpus export blocked
design routes to one bounded measured implementation or records a blocker
failure_criteria: design lacks measured pairing or action-divergence metrics
design routes directly to materialization training or private holdout
decision_rule: M1530 passes if it designs measured public source mining while preserving no-materialization and no-training guardrails.
